metadata.title: Model weights and developer toolchains review
metadata.description: Review known locations of downloaded AI model weights and installed language toolchains. Re-downloads can be slow or impossible for gated models, and removing an installed tool breaks the projects that use it.

metadata.title: Assistant session history review
metadata.description: Review known Claude and Codex conversation locations. These are valuable records, not disposable cache.

metadata.title: Credential and key stores review
metadata.description: Review known locations of SSH, GnuPG, cloud CLI and password-store secrets. Keys and tokens cannot be regenerated from files; nothing here is disposable.

metadata.title: Repository metadata review
metadata.description: Review version-control metadata at the root of a scanned project. History in these folders can be the only copy of commits, stashes and branches that were never pushed.
